## Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

1. Go to '...'
2. Tap on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

A clear description of what actually occurred.

If applicable, add screenshots or videos to help explain the problem (ensure no personal sensitive data is visible).

* **Device**: [e.g. iPhone 15 Pro, Google Pixel 8]

Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. local offline state, biometric unlock type used).
